# Skill rules

What `skills/skill-authoring` enforces a skill tree against. Every rule
below is emitted by the validator — `aa skills validate` — so this page
cannot state a constraint the checker does not enforce, and the checker
cannot enforce a constraint this page does not state. Provenance for each
rule (the loader file it was first read from, or the failure mode that
motivated it) lives in `RULES.md`, next to this file.

- **Rules:** 13
- **Levels:** `error` (a rule violation fails the skill or category it hits)
- **SSOT:** `modules/shared/src/skills/taxonomy_skills_constant.py` —
  `NAME_RE`, `MAX_DESCRIPTION_LEN`, and `issue_message()` read their
  constants from there.

## Rules

### `name-mismatch` — Frontmatter `name:` equals the skill directory name

- **Rule ID:** `name-mismatch`
- **Level:** `error`
- **Issue type:** `name-mismatch` (the string `validate` prints)
- **Fields:** `dir` (the skill's directory name), `name` (the skill's frontmatter name)

**Message (verbatim from `ISSUE_MESSAGES`):**

> Frontmatter name '{name}' does not match directory '{dir}'.

**Provenance:** `create-skills/SKILL.md` (name must equal the directory)

### `name-format` — Skill names are lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens

- **Rule ID:** `name-format`
- **Level:** `error`
- **Issue type:** `invalid-skill-name` (the string `validate` prints)
- **Fields:** constant message

**Message (verbatim from `ISSUE_MESSAGES`):**

> Directory name must be lowercase a-z, 0-9, hyphens, 2-64 chars, no leading/trailing hyphen or double hyphen.

**Provenance:** `create-skills/SKILL.md` and `create-skills/references/validation-criteria.md` (both stated the name alphabet)

### `description-present` — Every skill carries a `description:`

- **Rule ID:** `description-present`
- **Level:** `error`
- **Issue type:** `missing-description` (the string `validate` prints)
- **Fields:** constant message

**Message (verbatim from `ISSUE_MESSAGES`):**

> SKILL.md description is missing.

**Provenance:** `create-skills/SKILL.md` (required frontmatter shape)

### `description-characters` — Descriptions contain no `<`, `>`, or `"`

- **Rule ID:** `description-characters`
- **Level:** `error`
- **Issue type:** `invalid-description-characters` (the string `validate` prints)
- **Fields:** constant message

**Message (verbatim from `ISSUE_MESSAGES`):**

> Description contains <, >, or double quote characters.

**Provenance:** `create-skills/SKILL.md` (Grok Build embeds the value in `<skill description="...">`)

### `description-length` — Descriptions are at most 1024 characters

- **Rule ID:** `description-length`
- **Level:** `error`
- **Issue type:** `description-too-long` (the string `validate` prints)
- **Fields:** `length` (the offending length in characters), `max_len` (the enforced maximum)

**Message (verbatim from `ISSUE_MESSAGES`):**

> Description is {length} chars; max is {max_len}.

**Provenance:** `create-skills/SKILL.md` and `validation-criteria.md` (both stated the 1,024-char ceiling)

### `skill-md-nesting` — A skill directory holds exactly one `SKILL.md`

- **Rule ID:** `skill-md-nesting`
- **Level:** `error`
- **Issue type:** `nested-skill-md` (the string `validate` prints)
- **Fields:** `paths` (every location the violation was found at)

**Message (verbatim from `ISSUE_MESSAGES`):**

> Nested SKILL.md files found: {paths}

**Provenance:** `create-skills/SKILL.md` (structure section: nested `SKILL.md` is rejected on upload)

### `skill-placement` — `SKILL.md` lives at `<category>/<skill>/SKILL.md`

- **Rule ID:** `skill-placement`
- **Level:** `error`
- **Issue type:** `invalid-placement` (the string `validate` prints)
- **Fields:** constant message

**Message (verbatim from `ISSUE_MESSAGES`):**

> SKILL.md is directly under a category; expected category/skill/SKILL.md.

**Provenance:** `create-skills/SKILL.md` (placement rule) and `skill-librarian/references/category-rules.md` (folder shape)

### `category-depth` — No nesting deeper than `<category>/<skill>/`

- **Rule ID:** `category-depth`
- **Level:** `error`
- **Issue type:** `too-deep` (the string `validate` prints)
- **Fields:** constant message

**Message (verbatim from `ISSUE_MESSAGES`):**

> SKILL.md is nested deeper than category/skill/SKILL.md.

**Provenance:** `create-skills/SKILL.md` (loaders walk one level) and `category-rules.md` (no nested subcategories)

### `unique-skill-name` — Each skill name is used by one folder only

- **Rule ID:** `unique-skill-name`
- **Level:** `error`
- **Issue type:** `duplicate-skill-name` (the string `validate` prints)
- **Fields:** `name` (the skill's frontmatter name), `paths` (every location the violation was found at)

**Message (verbatim from `ISSUE_MESSAGES`):**

> Skill name '{name}' appears in: {paths}.

### `unique-description` — No two skills share one description

- **Rule ID:** `unique-description`
- **Level:** `error`
- **Issue type:** `duplicate-description` (the string `validate` prints)
- **Fields:** `paths` (every location the violation was found at)

**Message (verbatim from `ISSUE_MESSAGES`):**

> Identical description appears in: {paths}.

### `category-description-present` — Every category has a `DESCRIPTION.md`

- **Rule ID:** `category-description-present`
- **Level:** `error`
- **Issue type:** `missing-category-description` (the string `validate` prints)
- **Fields:** constant message

**Message (verbatim from `ISSUE_MESSAGES`):**

> DESCRIPTION.md is missing.

**Provenance:** `skill-librarian/references/category-rules.md` (DESCRIPTION.md section)

### `category-description-nonempty` — Category `DESCRIPTION.md` describes the category

- **Rule ID:** `category-description-nonempty`
- **Level:** `error`
- **Issue type:** `empty-category-description` (the string `validate` prints)
- **Fields:** constant message

**Message (verbatim from `ISSUE_MESSAGES`):**

> DESCRIPTION.md has no description.

**Provenance:** `skill-librarian/references/category-rules.md` (the description decides where skills belong)

### `category-nonempty` — Every category holds at least one skill

- **Rule ID:** `category-nonempty`
- **Level:** `error`
- **Issue type:** `empty-category` (the string `validate` prints)
- **Fields:** constant message

**Message (verbatim from `ISSUE_MESSAGES`):**

> Category has no skills.
